newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open flat to up 0.10 cent.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open flat to up 0.10 cent.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.10 cent firmer Monday, based on market orders at 1017 EDT, dealers said.
Trade is expected to remain rangebound amid a dearth of news. Resistance remained at the recent high of 73.90 cents for July delivery, followed by 74.10 cents.
Friday, spot July settled 0.23 cent weaker at 73.15 cents per lb, traded 73.45 to 72.90 cents. Most-active December went out 0.17 cent lower at 76.02 cents.
Weather Services Corp noted rapid growth in Texas, California and Arizona. USDA will issue its weekly crop progress report following the close today.
